title: Keep a lower-scoring kind?
hook: One archive cell can improve while other kinds survive.

knows: A score to maximise over many candidates; distance between points.
doesNotKnow: Retain the best candidate in each chosen behaviour-descriptor cell.

objective: Retain the best candidate in each chosen behaviour-descriptor cell.
misconception: A search archive should keep only one global winner.

recall.question: A cell’s current best score is 7 and a new candidate scores 6. Another cell’s best score is 4. What happens to the new candidate?
recall.why: The candidate competes within its own cell: 6 loses to 7, regardless of the other cell’s score.
